prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ placeLabels }`. The function accepts `viewportWidth`, `viewportHeight`, and `labels`. Dimensions must be finite non-negative numbers. `labels` must be an array of records `{ text, width, height, color }`, where text and color are strings and width and height are finite non-negative numbers; malformed input throws `TypeError`. Return fresh records containing the original four fields plus `left` and `top`. Horizontally center every label. Vertically center the entire label stack with a fixed 8-unit gap between adjacent labels, preserving order. Empty labels return `[]`. Negative coordinates are allowed when content exceeds the viewport. Do not mutate inputs or retain aliases.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
